## Latest XKCD

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(htmltools)

# Read the data generated by the targets pipeline
data_path <- "data/xkcd.json"

if (file.exists(data_path)) {
  data <- jsonlite::read_json(data_path)
} else {
  # Fallback if running from subdirectory or if missing
  if (file.exists("../../data/xkcd.json")) {
     data <- jsonlite::read_json("../../data/xkcd.json")
  } else {
     data <- list(
       title = "Error Loading Data",
       explain_url = "#",
       img = "",
       alt = "Could not find data/xkcd.json"
     )
  }
}

# Use htmltools to generate the content safely
card_content <- div(class = "card",
  div(class = "card-header", data$title),
  div(style = "text-align: center; padding: 20px;",
    a(href = data$explain_url, target = "_blank", title = data$explain_url,
      img(src = data$img, title = data$alt, style = "max-width: 100%; height: auto; cursor: pointer;")
    )
  ),
  div(class = "card-footer text-muted", data$alt)
)

card_content
```

```{=html}
<script>
// Immediately unregister any service workers to fix the "cannot open connection" Shinylive error
if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
  navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations().then(function(registrations) {
    for(let registration of registrations) {
      console.log('Unregistering Service Worker:', registration);
      registration.unregister();
    }
  });
}
</script>
```
